verdict.rationale: EFTPS is a federal tax payment service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a web site, a phone voice response system, and downloadable Batch Provider Software. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and nothing mentions an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
